name: A. G. Gillingham
description: Documented New Zealand GIS and spatial-information contribution, 1993–2000.
story: A. G. Gillingham is named as a co-author of 'Precision Agriculture Applications in New Zealand' in the proceedings index for the 13th Annual Fertilizer and Lime Research Centre workshop held at Massey University in February 2000.
The publication records Gillingham's contribution to the discussion of precision agriculture in New Zealand. The index does not establish Gillingham's particular technical tasks or full given names.
